summary: Allied Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, reporting a change of auditor. KPMG LLP notified the company on August 6, 2026, that it would not conduct the audit for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and Deloitte LLP was appointed on August 14, 2026. The change was approved by the audit committee and board. KPMG's reports contained no modified opinions and no reportable events. This is a routine auditor transition, not a special situation. No deal terms are involved. What to watch: potential regulatory or investor scrutiny of the auditor change, though no material event is indicated.
